content:
Aisha: Heads-up — we're seeing a new p99 latency bump on chat-13b starting ~08:12 UTC, coincides with a driver patch + triton rollout. p50 OK, p99 ~2.4x.
Tom: I saw the perf alert. Any noisy tenant on those hosts? :thinking_face:
perf-bot: alert: cluster=prod-g5x, model=chat-13b, metric=p99_latency, delta=+140%, window=5m, hosts=[g5x-34,g5x-35]
Nadia: Posting flamegraph from the 08:15 trace — kernel selection shows sudden switch to flash-attn-kernel for short seqs, NV driver stamped 525.60.11
Liu: Odd — flash-attn should be faster. Do we have KV cache behavior traces? Could be eviction thrash.
Aisha: Attached profiler snippet (shortened):
```
triton_driver: choose_kernel(model=chat-13b, seq=32)
-> flash_attn_fwd_v2 (workspace=48MB)
kv_cache: misses++ (prefetch evict=1.3x)
cudaMalloc/Free high wall time
```
Tom: That workspace hit is bigger than expected for short seqs. Possibly new kernel uses bigger workspace leading to more frequent workspace allocation, touching host-side alloc path.
Nadia: Also saw increased `cudaMemcpyAsync` spikes and page-faults on g5x-35. Host memory pressure + smaller KV affinity caused more cross-stream evictions.
Aisha: Here's command I ran to reproduce locally on a canary node:
```
# reproduce short-seq mix
./run_perf.sh --model chat-13b --batch_profile --seq 32 --clients 60
``` 
Liu: Reproduced locally when forcing triton kernel selector to prefer flash-attn_v2. Without it, p99 drops back to baseline.
Tom: So regression path: driver/triton tweak -> selector prefers flash kernel -> bigger workspace + different mem access -> KV cache misalignment -> eviction thrash -> p99 spike.
Nadia: Proposed mitigations:
- temp override: pin kernel selector to `attn_generic` for short seqs (config rollback) 
- roll back driver on suspect hosts if override not safe
- add adaptive-batcher tweak to avoid micro-bursts that stress KV prefetch
Aisha: I'll push a canary config to force fallback on a subset (g5x-35) and watch.
deploy-bot: config-rollout: started rollout of selector-override to g5x-35, percentage=10%
Tom: Quick telemetry check — also confirm cache hit ratio after override. If hit ratio improves, we confirm eviction link.
Liu: I captured two perf traces (08:14 before override, 08:22 after override). Uploading links: https://files/redwood/profiles/1768508_before.svg and /after.svg
Nadia: After 10% rollout p99 on canary host dropped 35% within 3 minutes. Looks promising.
Aisha: Filing incident doc and postmortem stub, marking for eng-runtime and eng-ml review. Next steps: export selector telemetry, add unit test for workspace footprint regression, and schedule kernel perf A/B for next rollout.
Tom: Also add automated alert for sudden kernel-selection flips per model (delta>20% in 1m) — avoid silent regressions.
Nadia: I'll open PR for selector-override + test vector. Tagging @Liu for perf tests.
Liu: On it. Will attach microbench harness and KV-affinity profiler.
perf-bot: note: incident created - id INC-2026-0457, severity=medium, linked-channel=eng-runtime
Aisha: Thanks everyone. Keep updates here.
